purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official MC Jhelum publishes a city base-map PDF whose legend explicitly includes parcel boundaries. Punjab PULSE/PLRA public viewer material lists Jhelum cadastral maps and parcels, but the referenced ArcGIS REST service and layer metadata routes returned HTTP 499 Token Required. No viewer token was requested or used. No anonymous safe polygon response, parcel ID, schema, or CRS was retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map evidence is present through MC Jhelum’s official parcel-boundary base map; district revenue administration and LRMIS custody are documented by the official Jhelum district portal. This is registry/map evidence, not proof of legal title scope or complete citywide vector coverage.
